newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Mid-West power eases on generation returns.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Mid-West power eases on generation returns.

text.p: U.S. Midwestern spot wholesale electricity prices eased Friday with the expected return of some idled generation and talk that line flow problems from Canada would be remedied, industry sources said.
Central Illinois Public Service was expected to restart its idled 900 megawatt Coffeen coal-fired plant Friday afternoon after repairs to boiler tube leaks.
Also, Manitoba Hydro was expected to remedy export restrictions to the U.S. over the weekend, the brokers and marketers said.

Peak, non-firm power for Saturday delivery in the Mid-Continent Area Power Pool (MAPP) region were said to have been talked in the $15.00-16.00 range, with Sunday at $14.00-15.00 and Monday at $16.00-17.00, down from Thursday discussion at $23.00-24.00, the brokers and marketers said.
Off-peak non-firm MAPP power was said to be lower at $10.00-11.50 per megawatt hour (MWh).

In the Mid-American Interpool Network (MAIN), non-firm peak power was talked very close to MAPP prices, with Saturday pegged at $15.00-16.00, Sunday at $14.00-15.00 and Monday at $16.00-17.00, from Thursday morning talk at $21.00-22.00.
Off-peak next day MAIN power was pegged steady at $12.00-14.00 per MWh.

In the East Central Area Coordination Agreement (ECAR), peak, non-firm electricity prices for the weekend were assessed at $16.00-17.50 and Monday at $18.00-20.00 from next-day discussion on Thursday at $19.00-19.50, the brokers and marketers said.
Off-peak next-day ECAR power was talked steady in the $12.50-14.00 area, the sources said.
November ECAR prices held at $17.00-17.40, while December was pegged steady at $18.70-19.10.

In the Southwest Power Pool (SPP), peak, non-firm power for Saturday delivery was pegged at $16.00-17.00, Sunday at $15.00-16.00 and Monday at $18.50-20.00, from Thursday discussion at $19.00-23.00, the sources said.
Off-peak prices in SPP held steady in the $12.00-14.00 area, the sources said.
December SPP was talked steady at $21.00-21.30, the sources said.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
